name: ai.nextbillion.assettracking.receiver.BatteryLevelReceiver
description: Android battery-level broadcasts trigger the NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK receiver. It forwards the percentage so the tracking service can include it with location records and show low-battery warnings.
disableEffect: Disabling the manifest entry does not stop location tracking or battery updates during an active tracking session; the SDK also listens for battery changes while tracking.
